fusions.name: Night-Feeding Sting
fusions.desc: Flits a sting at the first enemy in front of you for 4 poison damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Echoing Grotto
fusions.desc: Shrieks into a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 11 resonating damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Vibrant Echo] for 6 seconds. The echo carries your afflictions on each target to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Roost in the Dark
fusions.desc: Draws you back into the reef: you restore 10 health and are veiled for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Lapping the Wound
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
